COLS.forEach(c => {
  const th = document.createElement('th');
  let label = c.label;
  if (c.direction === 'up') label += ' ↑';
  if (c.direction === 'down') label += ' ↓';
  th.textContent = label;
  th.dataset.field = c.field;
  if (!c.default) th.classList.add('col-extra');
  // Native browser tooltip: description on hover. Falls back to field name
  // when no description is provided. Accessible by default; no custom JS.
  th.title = c.description ? (c.description + '  (' + c.field + ')') : c.field;
  th.addEventListener('click', () => {
    primaryRankMode = false;
    if (sortField === c.field) sortAsc = !sortAsc;
    else { sortField = c.field; sortAsc = (c.direction === 'down'); }
    curPage = 0;
    render();
  });
  headerRow.appendChild(th);
});

// CW/RP/ERP/DarkRP scores + the stamina descriptor append "*" for Quick-tier
// rows (evaluation_tier < 0.5). Footnote at page bottom explains the marker.
const QUICK_MARK_FIELDS = new Set(['cw_score_v2', 'rp_score_v2', 'erp_score', 'dark_rp_score', 'stamina_retention']);

function buildValueNode(v, c, row) {
  // Returns a single DOM node (Text or Element) for this cell value.
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') {
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'nodata';
    span.textContent = '—';
    // Withheld-vs-low distinction (R9): a dash is missing data, never a
    // measured zero — say so on hover.
    span.title = 'insufficient data — not yet measured';
    return span;
  }
  if (typeof v === 'number') {
    if (c.percent) return document.createTextNode((v * 100).toFixed(c.decimals) + '%');
    const scaled = (c.scale && c.scale !== 1) ? v * c.scale : v;
    let text = (c.decimals !== null && c.decimals !== undefined)
      ? scaled.toFixed(c.decimals) : String(scaled);
    if (row && QUICK_MARK_FIELDS.has(c.field) && (row.evaluation_tier ?? 1) < 0.5) {
      text += '*';
    }
    return document.createTextNode(text);
  }
  return document.createTextNode(String(v));
}

function hfPathFromUrl(url) {
  // Parse "https://huggingface.co/author/model-name" → "author/model-name".
  // Returns null if the URL doesn't match the expected shape.
  if (!url) return null;
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (u.hostname !== 'huggingface.co') return null;
    const path = u.pathname.replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return path || null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

function buildModelCell(row) {
  // Returns a DocumentFragment: model name (link to detail page) + optional
  // HF icon-link + class badge + lineage subtext. The primary clickable
  // surface is now the Caliper detail page at /m/<slug>/ — that's our
  // canonical URL. HuggingFace gets a small adjacent icon-link.
  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.className = 'model-name';
  link.href = '/m/' + encodeURIComponent(row.slug) + '/';
  link.textContent = row.display_name || row.slug || '';
  frag.appendChild(link);

  const cls = row.model_class || '';
  if (cls) {
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'badge ' + cls.toLowerCase();
    badge.textContent = cls;
    frag.appendChild(badge);
  }
  // Reasoning is an orthogonal quality, not a type — its own badge.
  if (row.is_reasoning) {
    const rb = document.createElement('span');
    rb.className = 'badge reasoning';
    rb.textContent = 'Reasoning';
    frag.appendChild(rb);
  }
  if (row.is_mtp) {
    const mb = document.createElement('span');
    mb.className = 'badge mtp';
    mb.textContent = 'MTP';
    frag.appendChild(mb);
  }

  // Subtext: the model's own formal HF id (owner/repo), plus a tiny
  // HuggingFace icon linking to the repo. Prefer huggingface_url (strip the
  // host); fall back to the first lineage entry (which is this model).
  let hfUrl = row.huggingface_url || '';
  let hfId = '';
  if (hfUrl) {
    hfId = hfUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\/huggingface\.co\//, '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  } else if (row.lineage) {
    try { hfId = JSON.parse(row.lineage)[0] || ''; } catch (e) { hfId = ''; }
  }
  if (hfId) {
    const sub = document.createElement('span');
    sub.className = 'lineage';
    sub.textContent = hfId;
    const hf = document.createElement('a');
    hf.className = 'hf-icon';
    hf.href = hfUrl || ('https://huggingface.co/' + hfId);
    hf.target = '_blank';
    hf.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    hf.title = 'Open on HuggingFace';
    hf.textContent = ' 🤗';
    sub.appendChild(hf);
    frag.appendChild(sub);
  }
  return frag;
}

function render() {
  // Filter
  const q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  // Whitespace-separated terms, ALL of which must appear somewhere in the row's
  // searchable text — order-independent. "qwen readyart" matches a ReadyArt Qwen
  // tune; matching the literal phrase (the old behaviour) found nothing, because
  // no display name contains those two words adjacent in that order.
  const terms = q ? q.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const klass = classFilter.value;
  const reasoning = reasoningFilter.value;
  const bandSel = selectedBands();
  // Proprietary = closed-weights API anchors (no parameter count). Default ON so
  // the board is unchanged unless the user opts out; unchecking gives an
  // open-weights-only view without disturbing the Type select.
  const inclProp = propFilter.checked;
  let rows = DATA.filter(r => {
    if (terms.length) {
      const hay = ((r.display_name || '') + ' ' + (r.slug || '') + ' ' +
                   (r.lineage || '')).toLowerCase();
      if (!terms.every(t => hay.includes(t))) return false;
    }
    if (klass && r.model_class !== klass) return false;
    if (!inclProp && r.model_class === 'Proprietary') return false;
    if (reasoning === 'yes' && !r.is_reasoning) return false;
    if (reasoning === 'no' && r.is_reasoning) return false;
    if (bandSel.size && !bandSel.has(r.param_band)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // Sort. In rank-by mode the key is the chosen headline score, nulls last,
  // always descending; otherwise it's the active column.
  const sortVal = primaryRankMode ? (r => fieldVal(r, primaryRankField))
                                  : (r => fieldVal(r, sortField));
  const asc = primaryRankMode ? false : sortAsc;
  rows.sort((a, b) => {
    const av = sortVal(a), bv = sortVal(b);
    const an = (av === null || av === undefined) ? -Infinity : av;
    const bn = (bv === null || bv === undefined) ? -Infinity : bv;
    let cmp;
    if (typeof an === 'number' && typeof bn === 'number') {
      cmp = asc ? an - bn : bn - an;
    } else {
      cmp = asc ? String(an).localeCompare(String(bn))
                : String(bn).localeCompare(String(an));
    }
    if (cmp !== 0) return cmp;
    // Complete-first tie-break: at an equal score, the Full-tier model ranks
    // ahead of a Quick-tier one (Quick is the K=1 noisy proxy). Always Full-first
    // regardless of sort direction — completeness is the confidence signal.
    const at = (a.evaluation_tier == null) ? -1 : a.evaluation_tier;
    const bt = (b.evaluation_tier == null) ? -1 : b.evaluation_tier;
    return bt - at;
  });

  // Update header indicators. Primary rank mode is controlled above the table.
  document.querySelectorAll('thead th').forEach(th => {
    th.classList.remove('sort-asc', 'sort-desc');
    if (!primaryRankMode && th.dataset.field === sortField) {
      th.classList.add(sortAsc ? 'sort-asc' : 'sort-desc');
    }
  });

  if (vernote) {
    vernote.innerHTML = BANDED
      ? 'Scoring adjusted for consistency on RP / ERP / DarkRP — see <a href="/methodology.html">Methodology</a>.'
      : 'Original scoring, preserved for continuity.';
  }

  // ── Pagination: clamp the current page, slice to the active window ──
  const total = rows.length;
  const ps = (pageSize === 'all') ? (total || 1) : pageSize;
  const totalPages = (pageSize === 'all' || total === 0) ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / ps);
  if (curPage >= totalPages) curPage = totalPages - 1;
  if (curPage < 0) curPage = 0;
  const startIdx = (pageSize === 'all') ? 0 : curPage * ps;
  const endIdx = (pageSize === 'all') ? total : Math.min(startIdx + ps, total);
  const pageRows = rows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

  // Render rows — clear and rebuild via DOM nodes. Rank is the GLOBAL position
  // (startIdx + i + 1), not the page-relative index.
  while (tbody.firstChild) tbody.removeChild(tbody.firstChild);
  pageRows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    COLS.forEach(c => {
      const td = document.createElement('td');
      if (!c.default) td.classList.add('col-extra');
      if (c.field === 'rank') {
        td.textContent = String(startIdx + i + 1);
      } else if (c.field === 'display_name') {
        td.appendChild(buildModelCell(r));
      } else {
        td.appendChild(buildValueNode(fieldVal(r, c.field), c, r));
      }
      tr.appendChild(td);
    });
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });

  countEl.textContent = (total ? (startIdx + 1) : 0) + '–' + endIdx + ' of ' + total +
                        (total !== DATA.length ? ' (filtered from ' + DATA.length + ')' : '');
  pgInfo.textContent = 'Page ' + (curPage + 1) + ' / ' + totalPages;
  pgFirst.disabled = pgPrev.disabled = (curPage <= 0);
  pgNext.disabled = pgLast.disabled = (curPage >= totalPages - 1);
}

// Caliper v2 publishes the consistency-adjusted figure (mean of the 4 card x
// run sessions, minus half its standard error). CW keeps its
// pooled value: it averages 33 independent prompts and its measured error is
// ~8x smaller, so there is nothing meaningful to adjust away.
// The willingness family maps the same way: v2 reads the corrected refusal
// verdicts, v1 the frozen ones. fieldVal falls back to the v1 value when a
// model has no v2 reading, so a partially-rescored field never shows blanks.
const ADJ_FOR = {
  rp_score_v2: 'rp_score_adj',
  erp_score: 'erp_score_adj',
  dark_rp_score: 'dark_rp_score_adj',
  willingness: 'willingness_v2',
  refusal_pass_rate: 'refusal_pass_rate_v2',
  calibration_refusal_normal: 'calibration_refusal_normal_v2',
  calibration_refusal_extreme: 'calibration_refusal_extreme_v2',
  calibration_engagement_density: 'calibration_engagement_density_v2',
  c0_refusal_rate: 'c0_refusal_rate_v2',
  c1_refusal_rate: 'c1_refusal_rate_v2',
  c2_engagement_rate: 'c2_engagement_rate_v2',
  c3_refusal_rate: 'c3_refusal_rate_v2',
  c4_engagement_rate: 'c4_engagement_rate_v2'
};
// value actually shown/ranked for a field, honouring the active version
function fieldVal(r, field) {
  if (BANDED) {
    const a = ADJ_FOR[field];
    if (a && typeof r[a] === 'number') return r[a];
  }
  return r[field];
}

let BANDED = true;
const vernote = document.getElementById('vernote');
function applyVersion() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('v1', !BANDED);
  document.getElementById('v2').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(BANDED));
  document.getElementById('v1').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!BANDED));
  try { localStorage.setItem('caliper-version', BANDED ? '2' : '1'); } catch (e) {}
  curPage = 0;
  render();
}
document.querySelectorAll('.vertabs button').forEach(b => {
  b.addEventListener('click', () => { BANDED = (b.dataset.ver === '2'); applyVersion(); });
});
try { if (localStorage.getItem('caliper-version') === '1') BANDED = false; } catch (e) {}

document.querySelectorAll('.rank-option').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    primaryRankMode = true;
    primaryRankField = btn.dataset.rankField;
    document.querySelectorAll('.rank-option').forEach(b => {
      b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn);
    });
    curPage = 0;
    render();
  });
});

// Column-view toggle: default shows only the curated key columns; clicking
// reveals all columns via body.cols-all. State persists in localStorage so the
// preference survives reloads. Sorting (incl. by extra columns) is unaffected.
const toggleCols = document.getElementById('toggle-cols');
function applyColsState(showAll) {
  document.body.classList.toggle('cols-all', showAll);
  toggleCols.textContent = showAll ? 'Show key columns only' : 'Show all columns';
}
let colsAll = false;
try { colsAll = localStorage.getItem('caliper-cols-all') === '1'; } catch (e) {}
applyColsState(colsAll);
toggleCols.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const showAll = !document.body.classList.contains('cols-all');
  applyColsState(showAll);
  try { localStorage.setItem('caliper-cols-all', showAll ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {}
});

function commitSearchUrl() {
  const u = new URL(location.href);
  const q = search.value.trim();
  if (q) u.searchParams.set('search', q);
  else u.searchParams.delete('search');
  window.location.assign(u.toString());
}

// Filters reset to page 1 so you never sit on an out-of-range page after the
// row set shrinks.
function filterRender() { curPage = 0; render(); }
search.addEventListener('input', filterRender);
search.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    commitSearchUrl();
  }
});
classFilter.addEventListener('change', filterRender);
reasoningFilter.addEventListener('change', filterRender);
bandCbs.forEach(c => c.addEventListener('change', () => { updateBandSummary(); filterRender(); }));
bandAll.addEventListener('change', () => {
  // Reset-only control. Checking it drops every band back to the all-sizes view;
  // unchecking it would mean "show nothing", so updateBandSummary snaps it back on.
  bandCbs.forEach(c => c.checked = false); updateBandSummary(); filterRender();
});
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (bandDetails.open && !bandDetails.contains(e.target)) bandDetails.open = false;
});
propFilter.addEventListener('change', filterRender);

// Pagination controls. Out-of-range pages are clamped inside render().
pgFirst.addEventListener('click', () => { curPage = 0; render(); });
pgPrev.addEventListener('click', () => { curPage -= 1; render(); });
pgNext.addEventListener('click', () => { curPage += 1; render(); });
pgLast.addEventListener('click', () => { curPage = 1e9; render(); });
pageSizeSel.addEventListener('change', () => {
  pageSize = (pageSizeSel.value === 'all') ? 'all' : parseInt(pageSizeSel.value, 10);
  curPage = 0;
  render();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
